AbstractText.Label: PURPOSE
AbstractText.content: To assess the risk of locally aggressive behavior in pure Gleason Score 6 (GS6) (Grade Group 1) prostate cancer, using contemporary grading criteria, which has only been studied in one prior cohort.

AbstractText.Label: MATERIALS AND METHODS
AbstractText.content: Consecutive radical prostatectomy (RP) specimens from an academic institution including 3291 men with GS6 and 4202 men with Gleason score 3+4=7 (GS347) (Grade Group 2) between 2005-2016.

AbstractText.Label: STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
AbstractText.content: For dichotomous variables, the Pearson's chi-square test.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS & LIMITATIONS
AbstractText.content: Of the GS6 cancers, 128/3288 (3.9%) cases showed focal extra prostatic extension (EPE) compared to 593/4202 (14.1%) cases with GS347 (p<0.0001). Of the GS6 cancers, 79/3288 (2.4%) cases showed non-focal EPE compared to 639/4202 (15.2%) cases with GS347 (p<0.0001). The incidence of focal EPE with GS347 with <5% Gleason pattern 4 was 129/1147 (11.2%) which was in between GS6 and GS347 with >5% Gleason pattern 4. The incidence of non-focal extra-prostatic extension with GS347 with <5% Gleason pattern 4 was 96/1147 (8.4%), which was in between GS6 and GS347 with >5% Gleason pattern 4. Of the GS6 cases, 1/3290 (0.03%) cases showed SVI compared to 93/4202 (2.2%) cases with GS347 (p<0.0001). A limitation of our study is its retrospective design.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSIONS
AbstractText.content: It is not rare for pure GS6 prostate cancer to locally extend out of the prostate (3.9% focally and 2.4% non-focally). Extremely rarely GS6 can be associated with SVI, yet not lymph-node metastases. Our overall findings support the argument for continuation of using the term cancer for these tumors.

Article.ArticleTitle: Incidence of Extra-Prostatic Extension at Radical Prostatectomy with Pure Gleason Score 3+3=6 (Grade Group 1) Cancer: Implications for Whether Gleason Score 6 Prostate Cancer Should be Renamed as "not Cancer" and for Selection Criteria for Active Surveillance.
